cli.title: ga-sprite-birds - Video Sprite Search Tool
cli.description: GA Sprite Birds - Audio Reading System CLI Mode

help.rate: Speech rate (0.5-2.0, 1.0 is normal, default: use config)
help.language: Interface language (en_US, zh_CN, default: use config)
help.analyze_characters: Character analysis mode: analyze novel characters and generate voice template (exit after generation)
help.multi_voice: Enable multi-character voice mode (true/false, use config if not specified)
help.character_template: Specify character voice template file path (optional, default: auto-find cache/role/[filename]_characters.json)
help.character_list: Specify character list file path (hybrid mode): one character per line, optional format 'CharacterName Gender'
help.analysis_mode: Character analysis mode (override CHARACTER_ANALYSIS_MODE in config): auto=smart analysis+auto merge, hybrid=user-specified character list

examples.title: Examples:
examples.basic:
# Basic usage (use .env config)
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt
examples.output:
# Specify output directory
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt -o ./output/test
examples.voice:
# Specify voice (male)
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt --voice zh-CN-YunxiNeural
examples.no_llm:
# Disable LLM processing
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt --no-llm
examples.chapters:
# Generate chapters 1-10 only
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt --start 1 --end 10
examples.analyze_auto:
# Character analysis (smart mode, auto-merge duplicate characters)
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt --analyze-characters
examples.analyze_hybrid:
# Character analysis (hybrid mode, user-specified character list)
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt --analyze-characters --character-list characters.txt
examples.analyze_force:
# Character analysis (force hybrid mode)
  python cli.py -i debug/test.txt --analyze-characters --analysis-mode hybrid --character-list characters.txt
